higherTimeframeNeutrality.definition: On the previous completed higher-timeframe bar: abs(EMA20-EMA50) <= 0.50*ATR14 and abs(EMA50-EMA50[-5]) <= 0.50*ATR14.
higherTimeframeNeutrality.causality: Current/incomplete higher-timeframe bucket is never used.

localNeutrality.definition: On the completed signal bar: abs(EMA20-EMA50) <= 0.35*ATR14 and abs(EMA50-EMA50[-5]) <= 0.35*ATR14.

rangeLevels.source: prior completed 20-bar high/low from the frozen feature engine

entryMirror.long: next evaluated bar open must be > structural stop and <= prior20 midpoint.
entryMirror.short: next evaluated bar open must be < structural stop and >= prior20 midpoint.

targets.failure: No trade if target order or any R floor fails.

reference.events: Generic frozen E1 candidates with setupClass=SWEEP_RECLAIM only.
reference.goodOpportunityAudit: 1.25 ATR favorable barrier before 1.0 ATR adverse barrier, adverse wins same-bar ambiguity.

metrics.positiveMonth: UTC signal-month sum of net R > 0.
metrics.firstSecondHalf: Chronological midpoint of entered B1 trades.
metrics.concentration: max positive market-family total R / sum positive market-family total R.
metrics.bootstrapUtilityDelta: candidate-level B1 utility (net R or zero on abstain) minus frozen E1 baseline utility on the same reference event.

forbidden: Changing neutrality thresholds after B1 outcomes.
Changing wick, range-width, entry, stop or target rules after B1 outcomes.
Any time-validation or holdout access on B1 failure.
